## OpenClaw v2026.10.1

3,055 commits · 2,425 pull requests · 402 contributors

### Changes included in this release

The release notes and changelog contain the same content, presented in two formats:

- [Release notes](https://docs.openclaw.ai/releases/2026.10.1) — formatted for people, with expandable sections.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/openclaw/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.1.md) — plain Markdown for AI agents and tools.
